metadata.name: aa_mxe
metadata.description: AA × Arcium MXE: sealed trades for the x402 Autonomous Agent

instructions.name: award_rfq
docs: Queues `award_rfq`, which reveals only the winner and the winning price.

instructions.name: close_rfq
docs: Marks the RFQ `Closed` once `end_time` has passed. No MPC.

instructions.name: create_rfq
docs: Creates the `Rfq` PDA and queues `open_rfq_state` for the initial
encrypted state. Quotes are accepted until `end_time`.

instructions.name: create_scoreboard
docs: Creates the `Scoreboard` PDA and queues `open_scoreboard` for the empty
encrypted board.

instructions.name: joint_purchase
docs: Queues `joint_purchase` with every buyer's sealed cap in one call. Each
cap keeps its own owner key, which is what lets the circuit return each
share encrypted to its own buyer.

instructions.name: match_ceiling
docs: Queues `match_ceiling` with the buyer's encrypted ceiling against the
sealed floor.

instructions.name: place_quote
docs: Queues `place_quote` with one seller's encrypted quote and the current
encrypted state.

instructions.name: reveal_scores
docs: Queues `reveal_scores`, which reveals the per-seller aggregates only.

instructions.name: seal_floor
docs: Creates the `Negotiation` PDA and queues `seal_floor` with the seller's
encrypted floor. The floor is re-encrypted for the MXE in the callback.

instructions.name: set_catalog
docs: Writes the public catalog the search circuits read. Plain account, no
MPC: the catalog is public by design, only the query is sealed.
Stored on chain and read by the queue instruction, rather than passed
in it, so the search transaction carries only the sealed query whatever
the catalog size.

instructions.name: submit_rating
docs: Queues `submit_rating`. The slot (which seller) is encrypted along with
the rating, so neither the values nor the target leave MPC.

types.name: AwardRfqOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: Catalog
docs: The public catalog function 5 searches. Only the first `size` entries are
read. Plaintext by design — the catalog is public; the query is not.
Buyer i's share, encrypted to buyer i. Only buyer i can read slot i.

types.name: arcium_client::idl::arcium::types::Output
docs: An output of a computation.
We currently don't support encrypted outputs yet since encrypted values are passed via
data objects.

types.name: arcium_client::idl::arcium::types::Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: arcium_client::idl::arcium::types::SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.
